meaning: Independent bounded native State Machine controls over declared state and Event-trigger symbols, structural facts and declared Rule guards.
oracle: Validate every explicit input independently of factories. Enumerate all declared state/trigger pairs; select the unique source transition, bind its guard arguments and interpret its declared Rule closure. Preserve no-transition versus guard rejection, original state on rejection, exact transition identity, target state and ordered output slots including repeated Event references. Guardless and constant machines need no invented Rule or Policy-style input-sensitivity witness.
cases: Compare exported initialState and closed deeply frozen reducer outcomes. Include transitive Rule and guard-argument literals, exact structural inputs, malformed inputs even for unhandled pairs, invalid state/trigger carriers, and zero getters/coercion calls or caller mutation. Results contain unexecuted intent selectors, never Event occurrences or Operation results.
bounds: 4096 cases per whole node, 65536 project cases, 8 MiB serialized controls; independent guard evaluation shares 65536 visits/depth 64 per invocation. Exhaustion retains the entire source node as not_evaluable without a passing prefix or unreachable-transition claim.
execution: Use the existing private permission-restricted runner on actual generated modules. Bind native import resolution to the checked State Machine and Rule closure; forbid Event, Operation, factory and external imports before loading, including caught dynamic imports. No transport, publication, persistence or production provider effects.
compatibility: Retain all 49 source predecessors, source admission, old source and defaults. No State Machine generator, SFOL, AlchLang, Rule, Policy or collection behavior changes.
